title: Interests
subtitle: What I do when I step away from the keyboard.

items.title: Martial arts
items.text: Black belt in Japanese Jujitsu. Years of practice taught me discipline, attention to detail, and the value of consistent incremental progress — habits that carry directly into how I build software.

items.title: Travel & cultures
items.text: I love connecting with cultures different from my own — especially their spiritual traditions and the natural landscapes they grew out of. Every trip pushes me to think differently and come back with a wider perspective.

items.title: Mountain trekking
items.text: Long hikes on high-altitude trails are how I reset. Few things beat the silence above the treeline.

items.title: Strategy & RPG games
items.text: I'm hooked on role-playing and strategy games — anything that rewards systems thinking, long-term planning, and getting deeply attached to fictional characters.
